From: Paul Smith <paul.smith@medicorp.com>

Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@medicorp.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Operator evidence & insurance request for private deployment

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the call earlier. As we prep the Order Form and Private Deployment addendum, our security and procurement teams need a short list of assurances and artifacts so we can close the IRB for hosting. Please see the attached PDF for a consolidated request. High-level asks: 

- Evidence of operator cyber insurance (coverage summary, effective dates).
- Forensics playbook / chain-of-custody steps your ops team will follow if we need post-incident evidence.
- Snapshot/escrow-lite proposal for binary/config snapshots and frequency (we prefer quarterly + on-demand).
- SIEM/log access: what logs can be exported and retention windows.
- Attestation timeline: we need a window for delivery of artifacts once requested (ideally <= 30 days).

Can you confirm which of the above we can include as exhibits to the MSA/Order Form and propose contract language? We have an internal deadline to finalize Order Form redlines by 2026-08-26.

Attachments: medicorp_evidence_request.pdf (PDF; 3 pages)

If easier, I can loop procurement on a short call Wednesday.

Thanks,
Paul

Proposed internal timeline: draft deliverables by 2026-08-20, legal redlines by 2026-08-22, final Order Form by 2026-08-26. Does that align with you?

CC'ing Karthik and Priya to start the drafts.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operator evidence & insurance request for private deployment

Paul / Naomi —

Thanks for the note and the PDF. I've uploaded a redline package and a short summary of proposed compromise language. Attachments: MSA_redline_v3.docx, OrderForm_AttachB_draft.docx. Key points: 

- Operator insurance: we can provide a COI and a one-page summary of coverage. We are not able to expand our primary indemnity beyond the MSA cap; however, for on-prem/private deployments we can add an operator-liability carve-out limited to grossly negligent acts by operator staff handling customer data (suggested carve-out language in MSA_redline_v3).

- Forensics & chain-of-custody: propose an Exhibit B (forensics deliverables) that commits Redwood to provide a forensics playbook excerpt, a signed attestation of collection steps, and a secure transfer of evidence within 30 calendar days of a validated request. We also propose options for expedited evidence delivery (10 business days) for an additional professional services fee.

- Escrow-lite snapshots: suggest quarterly snapshots with a customer-initiated on-demand snapshot. Snapshot scope limited to runtime binaries, configuration manifests, and deployment metadata (no customer data). We propose retention of the last two quarterly snapshots for 12 months.

- Logs & SIEM exports: we can export request-level access logs and system-level audit logs in CSV or JSON. Retention options: default 90 days (hosted), dedicated deployments can extend to 365 days (subject to cost/Order Form).

I'll flag two legal asks for Medicorp: 1) acceptance of the snapshot scope (we can't include customer data in snapshots), and 2) an explicit indemnity carve-out for operator staff gross negligence — otherwise we will need to keep the MSA cap as-is.

Naomi/Dylan — once we have Medicorp's acceptance of those tradeoffs I'll fold them into the Order Form and generate a final redline for counters.

Karthik
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Operator evidence & insurance request for private deployment

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear redline and options. A few quick notes from Medicorp's security and procurement: 

- The snapshot scope limitation (no customer data) is acceptable to our security team, provided the chain-of-custody and integrity hashes are supplied.
- For operator insurance, procurement will need the COI and a binder page by next Tuesday (2026-08-25).
- The 30-calendar-day standard delivery window is acceptable; procurement would prefer the expedited 10 business day option be included as a defined, billable service.

We'll review the attached redlines internally and aim to come back with minor edits by end of day 2026-08-22. Once we confirm redlines we'll route a PO and kickoff the Order Form signature.

Also please confirm if Redwood can provide a named point of contact and contact number for the operator on-call who would handle evidence collection requests. That contact will be listed in Exhibit B.

Scheduling note: procurement asked for a 30-minute call Friday 2026-08-21 at 10:00 AM PDT to iron out commercial items — can you confirm?

Best,
Paul
